name: Protean — 3 Advanced — Shape of All Beasts

system.description: A combination power blending Protean's Shape of the Beast with Vicissitude. A Cainite who has mastered both, along with some knowledge of zoology and comparative anatomy, can take the form of any animal between the size of a tiger and a rabbit — and can force other beings into animal form as well. As with Shape of the Beast, the transformed Cainite retains her psyche but gains the natural abilities of her animal form: keener senses, flight, rapid swimming, even venom (no more lethal than normal for the species).
system.bloodCost: 1 blood point (transforming self); more to speed the change or to transform an unwilling target
system.duration: Indefinite; the character can hold animal form as long as she wishes and resume human form at will
system.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Five: Storytelling (Unique Abilities)
